_layering_principle: R9-D7: 本地有本地模型中心、外部有外部模型中心——本地模型调本地的（对话感知/checkpoint/自然回复，本地私有千问，端点经部署侧私有配置注入，不写入仓库），外部模型调外部的（意图/规划/总结/学习，aiops 网关）。local 通道显式声明本地模型中心。

local._base_url_note: loopback placeholder only; the private on-LAN address is injected at deploy time via a private model-center file pointed to by VHS_MODEL_CENTER (or VHS_EMAIL_STRATA for the pipeline) and is never committed

_timeout_note: UNVALIDATED: plan/research/diagnose were originally 60s/60s/30s, but a single strong-model planning run measured ~59.6s, leaving only 0.4s slack, which caused intermittent failures. Now unified at 180s, and must stay above L2PlanTimeout (120s), otherwise the client times out before the planner finishes.
